title: VHL payload at HCERT key 5 as a CBOR map
description: Stakeholder directive, in the context of Stakeholder directive: Verifiable Health Links follow IHE VHL, CBOR map at key 5; HCERT Specification, 3.2.7.1.5; IHE VHL ITI-YY3, 2:3.YY3.4.1.3 Expected Actions; IHE VHL ITI-YY4 Provide VHL. Stakeholder directive: Verifiable Health Links follow IHE VHL, CBOR map at key 5: “CBOR map primary”. IHE VHL ITI-YY3 Generate VHL, 2:3.YY3.4.1.3 Expected Actions: “SHALL contain the VHL payload embedded in HCERT claim structure (claim key -260, key 5)”.

statements.label: VHL payload at HCERT key 5 as a CBOR map
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL carry the VHL payload at HCERT claim -260 key 5 as a CBOR map with text keys, exp and v as CBOR integers. The verifier SHALL read key 5 as that map, and SHALL also accept a vhlink:/ text string there, so that VHLs built to IHE ITI-YY3 still verify.
